summary: Allocates a small object through an indirect allocator function pointer on a5 (entry +32, taking the object payload pointer at a5+40 and arguments 1 and 26), then, if the allocation succeeded, initializes the new object's header fields: zeroes the first dword, stores byte a1 at +16, byte a2 at +17, dword a3 at +18, and dword a4 at +22. Returns the allocated object pointer.

operations.description: Invoke the allocator through the function pointer at a5+32, passing the object pointer stored at a5+40 and the integer arguments 1 and 26; capture the returned pointer.
If the allocation returned a non-null pointer, proceed to initialize the object's fields.
Zero the first dword of the allocated object (offset +0).
Store byte parameter a1 at object offset +16.
Store byte parameter a2 at object offset +17.
Store dword parameter a3 at object offset +18.
Store dword parameter a4 at object offset +22.
Return the allocated object pointer (null when allocation failed).

clean_pseudocode: if (obj) { obj->flags = 0; obj->field16 = a1; obj->field17 = a2; obj->field18 = a3; obj->field22 = a4; }
